findings.highlight: The enemy is gone
findings.evidenceJa: 明確な敵がいなくなり
findings.governingReading: With no clear enemy remaining
findings.explanation: The absence of an identifiable enemy becomes the disappearance of a single definite enemy.

findings.highlight: black “void”
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い『孔』
findings.governingReading: black “hole”
findings.explanation: The concrete opening in the sky is again changed into an abstract void.

findings.highlight: The omnipotent grail
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる願いを叶える万能の杯
findings.governingReading: the omnipotent cup said to grant every wish
findings.explanation: The defining wish-granting function is omitted.

findings.highlight: It  I don’t know what condition she’s in, but it doesn’t seem like her life is in danger
findings.evidenceJa: 命に別状はなさそうだ
findings.governingReading: It does not appear that Illya’s life is in danger.
findings.explanation: Unremoved revision debris leaves the sentence grammatically broken.

findings.highlight: I won’t lose anyone else
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も失う事もない
findings.governingReading: no one else will be lost
findings.explanation: A general end to further loss becomes Shirou’s personal possession and loss of people.

findings.highlight: close enough that I could reach out to her
findings.evidenceJa: 手が触れあえる距離
findings.governingReading: a distance at which their hands could touch
findings.explanation: Reciprocal near-contact becomes only Shirou’s ability to reach.

findings.highlight: I clench my fists hard
findings.evidenceJa: 血が滲むほど拳を握りしめ
findings.governingReading: he clenches his fists until they bleed
findings.explanation: The bodily extremity of Shirou’s restraint is omitted.

findings.highlight: stifle the words about to come out of my mouth
findings.evidenceJa: 口からこぼれてしまいそうな気持ちを殺して
findings.governingReading: kills the feelings about to spill from his mouth
findings.explanation: Suppressed raw feeling is reduced to unsaid wording.

findings.highlight: means destroying her contract as well
findings.evidenceJa: 契約を断つという事
findings.governingReading: means severing the contract
findings.explanation: Release from the binding is framed as destruction of the contract.

findings.highlight: She will end her life as the king
findings.evidenceJa: 永遠に王のまま、その生涯を終える
findings.governingReading: She will end her life remaining a king forever.
findings.explanation: The permanence central to Shirou’s understanding of Saber’s chosen life is omitted.

findings.highlight: I want to scream for her to stay here
findings.evidenceJa: 剥き出しの心を叫びたくなる
findings.governingReading: he wants to cry out his naked heart and beg her to remain
findings.explanation: The exposed-heart image and emotional nakedness are omitted.

findings.highlight: something I should not do even for the sake of my life
findings.evidenceJa: 死んでもしてはいけない事だ
findings.governingReading: something he must not do even if it kills him
findings.explanation: An absolute prohibition maintained through death becomes a choice made for the sake of life.

findings.highlight: was filled with injuries
findings.evidenceJa: 傷だらけになりながらも
findings.governingReading: though she became covered in wounds
findings.explanation: A concrete scarred bodily image becomes malformed abstraction.

findings.highlight: still protected all the way through
findings.evidenceJa: それを守り抜いた少女
findings.governingReading: the girl who protected it through to the end
findings.explanation: The object and completion of Saber’s protection disappear, leaving an incomplete English predicate.

findings.highlight: so that in her final moments, she would be able to believe her path was the right one
findings.evidenceJa: 最期に、己の信じた道が間違いではなかったと迎える為に
findings.governingReading: so that at the end she could meet death knowing the path she believed in had not been mistaken
findings.explanation: An end faced in vindication becomes merely being able to hold a positive belief.

findings.highlight: the pride that she has held until the time of her death
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは死ぬ時まで続いたその誇り
findings.governingReading: the pride that probably continued until her death
findings.explanation: The narrator’s probability marker is omitted.

findings.highlight: Please fulfill your role
findings.evidenceJa: その責務を、果たしてくれ
findings.governingReading: Fulfill that duty/responsibility.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of Saber’s chosen obligation is weakened into generic role performance.

findings.highlight: The destroyed mountain is now a flat field
findings.evidenceJa: 何もかも吹き飛んだ山頂は、まったいらな荒野に変わっていた
findings.governingReading: The mountaintop, with everything blown away, had become a perfectly flat wilderness.
findings.explanation: Location, cause, and desolate terrain are generalized.

findings.highlight: The horizon is shining in gleaming gold
findings.evidenceJa: 地平線には、うっすらと黄金が射している
findings.governingReading: A faint gold light reaches across the horizon.
findings.explanation: Faint first light becomes emphatically gleaming.

findings.highlight: So, everything is over?
findings.evidenceJa: これで、終わったのですね
findings.governingReading: So, with this, it is over.
findings.explanation: Saber’s recognition of completion becomes a broader question about everything.

findings.highlight: Nothing more needs to be said
findings.evidenceJa: 口に出せる言葉がなくなった
findings.governingReading: He no longer has any words he can bring himself to say.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to speak becomes a judgment that further speech is unnecessary.

findings.highlight: In the end, there is one thing I must tell you
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に、一つだけ伝えないと
findings.governingReading: There is just one last thing I must tell you.
findings.explanation: A final message before disappearance becomes a generic concluding phrase.

findings.highlight: She is facing me
findings.evidenceJa: 振り向いた姿
findings.governingReading: She turns to face him.
findings.explanation: Saber’s final turn toward Shirou is reduced to a static orientation.

findings.highlight: I close my blinded eyes and open them again
findings.evidenceJa: 朝日で眩んでいた目をわずかに閉じて、開く
findings.governingReading: He briefly closes his eyes, dazzled by the morning sun, then opens them.
findings.explanation: The slight, momentary blink is turned into fully closing “blinded” eyes.

findings.highlight: Leaving no trace
findings.evidenceJa: ただ潔く、面影さえ残さない
findings.governingReading: Simply and resolutely, she leaves not even a vestige.
findings.explanation: The manner that characterizes Saber’s clean departure is omitted.

findings.highlight: keeping everything I lost close to my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 失ったもの、残ったものを胸に抱いて
findings.governingReading: holding both what he lost and what remained within his heart
findings.explanation: The surviving remainder is omitted from Shirou’s final emotional balance.

findings.highlight: wishing never to forget, and for it to never fade away
findings.evidenceJa: どうか長く色褪せぬよう、強く願って
findings.governingReading: wishing fervently that it might remain unfaded for a long time
findings.explanation: Intensity and the temporal nuance of memory are changed into an absolute.

findings.highlight: A distant land glowing in sunlight
findings.evidenceJa: 遠い、朝焼けの大地
findings.governingReading: A distant land in the glow of dawn
findings.explanation: The closing dawn image becomes generic sunlight.
